main_text.p: Scutulæ erant duodecim forma & magnitudine ad panes formandos. Leu.24.5.
Scutellæ erant scutularum tegmina, quibus in coquendo circumcludebantur panes vt forma eadem essent. Num. 4.7. vnde Scutellæ tegminis dicuntur.
Acerræ erant thuris cum panibus impositi receptacula, Leu.25.7.

p.i: Atq; huiusmodi erat mensa cum partibus & instrumentis suis instructa.

main_text.p: Qua figurabatur Deum semper in ecclesia mensam verbo & sacramentis instructam, ad continuum cum Christo conuiuium pro suis sanctis habere, & ipsis consilio omnia parare necessaria. Pfal. 36.9.10. & 65.3. Pro.9.2. Apoc.3.20. inter se comparatis. Etiam in coelo ante faciem suam facietatem perpetuam gaudiorum pro suis parasse. Psal. 16.11. Luc.22.16 inter se comparatis.
Lychnuchus erat ex auro puro, opere continente fabrifactus, vt septem lucernas à sacerdote accensas, ad lucem præbendum ab omni parte eius contineret. Exod.25.31.37.

page.notes: Right margin partly cut off by the gutter; the marginal words "Habe…" and the fragments of the adjoining page at the right edge are incomplete and marked as such. The brace diagram in lines 1 and 3 is rendered as an outline; the Panem/Thus and Scutulæ/Scutellæ braces are approximate. Several words in the body are doubtful due to print quality (e.g. "Lychnuchus", "præbendum", "parasse"), and the final line is truncated at the gutter. Marginal notes at right edge (letters "H", "P", "R", "ve", "an", "Ha", "bu", "Va", "cer", "nas", "cum") are fragments of the adjoining page and are not transcribed.
